text: The singular complex Sing(X) of a topological space X is a simplicial set whose n-simplices are:
choices: homotopy classes of maps Sⁿ → X
n-simplices of a CW decomposition of X
explanation: Sing(X)_n = Top(|Δ[n]|, X). The singular complex is the right adjoint to |−|. Its geometric realisation |Sing(X)| is weakly homotopy equivalent to X.
